Craticula MongoDB compiler: turns the canonical IR into an injection-safe MongoDB aggregation pipeline (Extended JSON).
Craticula execution adapter for the official MongoDB .NET driver: compiles the IR to an aggregation pipeline and runs it.
Craticula execution adapter for OpenSearch.Client: compiles the IR to a search body and runs it, with deep paging and streamed export.
Craticula search compiler: turns the canonical IR into an OpenSearch / Elasticsearch search request body.
Craticula SQL compiler: turns the canonical IR into parameterized, injection-safe SQL for PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite and Oracle.
